newsitem.title: USA: Wyser-Pratte, Spear Leeds raise Rexene stake.
newsitem.headline: Wyser-Pratte, Spear Leeds raise Rexene stake.

text.p: Investment adviser Guy Wyser-Pratte and New York brokerage Spear, Leeds & Kellogg said on Monday they raised their stake in Rexene Corp to 9.79 percent, from 7.41 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 447,900 additional shares of Rexene between October 15 and 25 at prices ranging from $12.75 to $13.00 a share. The purchases raised its holding to 1,841,200 shares, from 1,393,300 shares.
According to the filing, Wyser-Pratte holds 922,800 shares, representing a 4.91 percent stake in Rexene, a Dallas-based maker of resins and petrochemical products.
Wyser-Pratte purchased the stake for about $11.1 million. Spear Leeds holds 918,400 common shares or a 4.88 percent stake that it bought for $10.9 million, the filing showed.

In an initial filing on October 15, the group said Rexene's rejection in August of a $460 million unsolicited offer by privately-held Hunstman Corp was improper and not in the best interest of shareholders. It said it would seek to remove all or a majority of the Rexene directors at a special meeting that it is seeking to call.
The group did not report any progress in those plans in its filing with the SEC.
